                                  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => F z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →

declarations.type:
∀ {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} (m : Breakdown.PieceWeights C nE nM) (P : ℝ) (h : Breakdown.HarmonicBounds)
  (w : Breakdown.Space → ℝ) {k : ℕ} (Γ : Set Breakdown.Symmetry) (W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
  (act : Fin k → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) {w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ},
  m.IsAdmissible P h w W w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio →
    (ContDiff ℝ 2 fun z => W z.1 z.2) →
      Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic W →
        (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.divergenceAt (W σ) y = 0) →
          (∃ D, ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), ∀ j ≤ 2, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (W σ) y‖ ≤ D / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (j + 1)) →
            (∃ B, ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), w y ≤ B) →
              (∀ (i : Fin k), MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => act i z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                (∀ (i : Fin k), Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (act i)) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin k), (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖act i σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤) →
                    ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
                      (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                      (H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                      (g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                      Breakdown.IsPerturbation Γ P v G H g →
                        ∀ (κ : Fin k → ℝ) (F : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => F z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
                            Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic F →
                              (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖F σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤ →
                                Breakdown.IsRightSide W act κ v G g F →
                                  ∃ M,
                                    m.IsMultiplierField v G H M ∧
                                      m.seminormSq P v < ⊤ ∧
                                        Breakdown.periodNorm M ≤
                                            √((1 + epsSup + epsGradSup / √w₀) ^ 2 / m.c + ratio / m.cμ) *
                                              √(m.c * Breakdown.weightedEnergy w G H +
                                                  m.cμ * (m.seminormSq P v).toReal) ∧
                                          (∫⁻ (σ : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 1,
                                                ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space), m.densityPos P h w v G H W σ y) +
                                              ENNReal.ofReal (-m.multiplierGap P w act v G H κ F M) ≤
                                            ENNReal.ofReal (m.multiplierGap P w act v G H κ F M) +
                                              ∫⁻ (σ : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 1,
                                                ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space), m.densityNeg P h w v G H W σ y

                      (bound :
                          ∀ p ∈ d.box,
                            ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
                              (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                              (H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)

                                  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => F z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →

  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => v z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => G z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
      MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => H z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => g z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
          Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic v →
            Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic G →
              Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic H →
                Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic g →
                  (∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ), Breakdown.IsWeakGradient (v σ) (G σ)) →

                        ∀ (j : Fin 3),
                          Breakdown.IsWeakGradient (fun y => (G σ y) (Breakdown.unitVector j)) fun y =>
                            (H σ y).flip (Breakdown.unitVector j)) →
                      (∀ᵐ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ i, ((G σ y) (Breakdown.unitVector i)).ofLp i = 0) →

                                              (1 / 2) • (fderiv ℝ (φ z.1) z.2) z.2) =
                                        ∫ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space), inner ℝ (g z.1 z.2) (φ z.1 z.2)) →
                                  (∀ γ ∈ Γ, ∀ᵐ (z : ℝ × Breakdown.Space), v (z.1 + γ.2) (γ.1 z.2) = γ.1 (v z.1 z.2)) →

              Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic F →

declarations.type:
∀ {C : Type} (m : Breakdown.ModeWeights C) (P : ℝ) (b : Breakdown.FlowBounds C) (w : Breakdown.Space → ℝ) {k : ℕ}
  (Γ : Set Breakdown.Symmetry) (W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
  (act : Fin k → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space) {w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ},
  m.IsAdmissible P b w w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio →
    b.IsValid m W →
      (ContDiff ℝ 2 fun z => W z.1 z.2) →
        Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic W →
          (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.divergenceAt (W σ) y = 0) →
            (∃ D, ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), ∀ j ≤ 2, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (W σ) y‖ ≤ D / (1 + ‖y‖) ^ (j + 1)) →
              (∃ B, ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), w y ≤ B) →
                (∀ (i : Fin k), MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => act i z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin k), Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (act i)) →
                    (∀ (i : Fin k), (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖act i σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤) →
                      ∀ (v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space)
                        (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                        (H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                        (g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                        Breakdown.IsPerturbation Γ P v G H g →
                          ∀ (κ : Fin k → ℝ) (F : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => F z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
                              Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic F →
                                (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖F σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤ →
                                  Breakdown.IsRightSide W act κ v G g F →
                                    ∃ M,
                                      m.IsMultiplierField v G H M ∧
                                        m.frequencySeminormSq P v < ⊤ ∧
                                          Breakdown.periodNorm M ≤
                                              m.multiplierConstant w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio *
                                                √(m.c * Breakdown.weightedEnergy w G H +
                                                    m.cμ * (m.frequencySeminormSq P v).toReal) ∧
                                            (∫⁻ (σ : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 1,
                                                  ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space), m.densityPos P b w v G H W σ y) +
                                                ENNReal.ofReal (-m.multiplierGap P w act v G H κ F M) ≤
                                              ENNReal.ofReal (m.multiplierGap P w act v G H κ F M) +
                                                ∫⁻ (σ : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 1,
                                                  ∫⁻ (y : Breakdown.Space), m.densityNeg P b w v G H W σ y

declarations.name: Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.IsAdmissibleWeak.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {m : Breakdown.PieceWeights C nE nM} {P : ℝ} {h : Breakdown.HarmonicBounds}
  {w : Breakdown.Space → ℝ} {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space}
  {HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
  {w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ},
  Finite C →
    0 < m.c →
      m.c < 1 →
        0 < m.cμ →
          m.cμ < 1 →
            0 < P →
              0 < w₀ →
                (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), w₀ ≤ w y) →
                  Measurable w →
                    Breakdown.IsAxisymmetric w →
                      (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics, -β ∈ h.harmonics) →
                        (0, 0) ∈ h.harmonics →
                          (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space) (i : Fin 3),
                              (W σ y).ofLp i = ∑ β ∈ h.harmonics, (Breakdown.modeVel β W σ y i).re) →
                            (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                                ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                  √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeVel β W σ y)) ≤ h.ampW β y) →
                              (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                                  ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                    √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y)) ≤
                                      h.ampGradW β y) →
                                (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                                    ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                      √(Breakdown.cnormSq
                                            (Breakdown.curlOfGrad (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y))) ≤
                                        h.ampVort β y) →
                                  (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                                      ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                        √(Breakdown.cnormSq
                                              (Breakdown.curlGradOfSecondDeriv (Breakdown.modeSecondDeriv β HW σ y))) ≤
                                          h.ampGradVort β y) →
                                    (∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                        ‖Breakdown.curlVec (fderiv ℝ (W σ) (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤ h.supVort y) →
                                      (∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                          ‖Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.vortGradMap (HW σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤
                                            h.supGradVort y) →
                                        (∀ (β : Fin nE) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                            ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                                                  (m.epsP β).frame •
                                                    (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                                                      (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                                              (m.epsP β).speed y) →
                                          (∀ (β : Fin nM) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                              ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                                                    (m.muP β).frame •
                                                      (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                                                        (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                                                (m.muP β).speed y) →
                                            (∀ (β : Fin nE),
                                                ∃ Ωs > 0,
                                                  ∀ ι ∈ (m.epsP β).modes,
                                                    Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.epsP β).frame ι) →
                                              (∀ (β : Fin nM),
                                                  ∃ Ωs > 0,
                                                    ∀ ι ∈ (m.muP β).modes,
                                                      Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι) →
                                                (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space) (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                                                    (∑ β,
                                                          |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| *
                                                            (m.muP β).wt y) ^
                                                        2 ≤
                                                      ratio *
                                                        ∑ β,
                                                          |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| *
                                                              |Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι| *
                                                            (m.muP β).wt y) →
                                                  0 ≤ ratio →
                                                    (∀ (β : Fin nE) (y : Breakdown.Space), 0 ≤ (m.epsP β).wt y) →
                                                      (∀ (β : Fin nM) (y : Breakdown.Space), 0 ≤ (m.muP β).wt y) →
                                                        (∀ (β : Fin nE), ∃ K, LipschitzWith K (m.epsP β).wt) →
                                                          (∀ (β : Fin nM), ∃ K, LipschitzWith K (m.muP β).wt) →
                                                            (∀ (β : Fin nE), Breakdown.IsAxisymmetric (m.epsP β).wt) →
                                                              (∀ (β : Fin nM), Breakdown.IsAxisymmetric (m.muP β).wt) →
                                                                (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                    ∑ β, (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsSup) →
                                                                  (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                      ∑ β,
                                                                          Breakdown.PieceWeights.wtGrad (m.epsP β).wt
                                                                            y ≤
                                                                        epsGradSup) →
                                                                    (∃ B,
                                                                        ∀ (β : Fin nE) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                          ‖y‖ * (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ B) →
                                                                      (∃ B,
                                                                          ∀ (β : Fin nM) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                            (m.muP β).wt y ≤ B ∧
                                                                              ⋯ * (m.muP β).wt y ≤ B ∧
                                                                                ⋯ *
                                                                                    Breakdown.PieceWeights.wtGrad
                                                                                      (m.muP β).wt y ≤
                                                                                  B) →
                                                                        (∀ (β : Fin nE) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                            0 < (m.epsP β).share1 y ∧
                                                                              0 < (m.epsP β).share2 y ∧
                                                                                0 < (m.epsP β).len y ∧
                                                                                  0 < (m.epsP β).t0 y ∧ ⋯) →
                                                                          (∀ (β : Fin nM) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                              0 < (m.muP β).share y ∧
                                                                                0 < (m.muP β).t4 y) →
                                                                            (∀ (β : Fin nM), 0 < (m.muP β).eta) →
                                                                              (∀ (β : Fin nE),
                                                                                  Measurable (m.epsP β).share1 ∧
                                                                                    ⋯ ∧ ⋯) →
                                                                                (∀ (β : Fin nM), ⋯ ∧ ⋯) →
                                                                                  (∀ (β : Fin nE), ⋯) →
                                                                                    (∀ (β : Fin nM),
                                                                                        Breakdown.IsAxisymmetric
                                                                                            (m.muP β).share ∧

                                                                                            (m.muP β).t4) →
